column1: # Fixed line scans: SKIPL, COPYL, SIMPLE and NAMES. EOF = 256; opinfo answers remain runtime memory.
# SKIPL/COPYL consume the newline; EOF returns without consuming it.
# SIMPLE scans at most WORDMAX bytes after two spaces and looks up SIMPLE[intern(word)].
# NAMES scans r+digits after a non-letter; LETTER excludes r at NM0 to keep rows disjoint.
# META is an exact reserved-record probe; speculative scans never emit.
